title: Implement split screen layout and APVTS bindings
description:
Create or replace Source/PluginEditor.cpp only, implementing the class declared in Source/PluginEditor.h.

Requirements:
- setSize(920, 540) in the constructor; keep the fixed 46:27 frame.
- Apply CustomLookAndFeel; assign accent colours: left Sonic Maximizer region cyan, right Aural Exciter region amber (include FFT/SpectrumVisualizer), bottom master routing/matrix/I-O region green.
- Lay out the split-screen wireframe in resized(): left maximizer controls, right exciter controls plus spectrum, bottom master/routing/matrix/I-O and meters.
- Bind every control with juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState::SliderAttachment / ComboBoxAttachment / ButtonAttachment using the exact 19 parameter IDs from the processor APVTS (mismatch will assert at construction).
- Forward audio-to-UI display data into SpectrumVisualizer and MeterComponent only via existing lock-free/UI-safe APIs; do not allocate or lock on the audio thread from the editor.
- paint() draws section backgrounds/labels consistent with the three accent regions.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginEditor.h (h.1)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (APVTS IDs, editor factory stub)
- Source/GUI/* headers and any existing visualizer/meter APIs

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/PluginEditor.cpp. Do not touch PluginEditor.h, PluginProcessor.*, or verification docs.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.cpp implements PluginEditor constructor, destructor, paint, and resized
Editor uses fixed size 920x540 and split-screen layout with cyan/amber/green accent regions
All knobs/combos/toggles bind via APVTS SliderAttachment / ComboBoxAttachment / ButtonAttachment to the exact 19 parameter IDs
SpectrumVisualizer and MeterComponent are constructed and laid out in the editor
cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja && cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone completes with exit code 0
cppcheck --enable=all Source/PluginEditor.cpp reports no error-level issues blocking the build
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change APVTS parameter layout or IDs
add heap allocation or locks on the audio thread path

allowed: bind attachments to existing APVTS parameter IDs
forbidden: change plugin formats or CMake targets
